question: Should OpenClaw accept the experimental `claws update` preview and plan-integrity contract as a core lifecycle surface in this stacked Claw rollout?
rationale: This is a new core CLI and persisted ownership/provenance contract, not a repair of established behavior; the existing `maintainer` label and assignment indicate that implementation quality alone cannot settle the product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the staged core contract
options.body: Approve the read-only planner as the canonical experimental preview boundary, contingent on exact-head proof and completion of required checks.

options.title: Keep the lifecycle capability external
options.body: Decline the new core surface and redirect the grouped-update workflow to an external plugin or ClawHub-owned implementation.

options.title: Narrow the first stage
options.body: Request a smaller diagnostic-only preview contract before accepting integrity binding and broader lifecycle reconciliation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the staged core contract
recommendation.body: Approve the read-only planner as the canonical experimental preview boundary, contingent on exact-head proof and completion of required checks.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to this PR and authored the concrete lifecycle-safety review requirements reflected in the current implementation.
